title: Birthplace, Dave Perkins and neighborhood parades
summary: Happy was born on Dryades between Washington and Sixth; Dave Perkins lived nearby, and neighborhood parades were many.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Last time you were talking about different places you lived, you said this is the furthest down town you ever lived here?
The furthest I lived here.
Well, where were you born, exactly? You know where you were born? Oh, yeah.
Yeah, on drive between Washington and 6th.
Uh-huh.
And that's what my mother always told me. Uh-huh. And my mother, she was in the house after I got to be big. And she told me that where you was born.
Uh-huh.
The house is right there, yeah.
Where did Dave Perkins live?
On 6th, between... Drive and the Barone.
He wasn't far away then at all?
Not too far.
Did you know him when you were a little boy? Oh, sure I know him there.
Uh-huh. Before I had drums. From Owen, I used to run drums from Dave Perkins. You know, he used to run drums too. Uh-huh. For 50 cents a night, a dollar a night. Like that.
Were there lots of parades in that neighborhood? Yeah. In those days? Were there lots of parades in that neighborhood? Yeah.
There were more then and there, no. Because they had more organizations than they got now.
And a lot of them were in that neighborhood, huh?
They were from all over town, but they used to. Most of them from downtown, wouldn't want to come up town. The most of town wouldn't want to go downtown.
Did Willie Hightower live around there? Did you ever know him? Willie Hightower. For the Hightower. The Hightower.
The Hightower. I don't know too much of where Hightower. I always think. Oh, Mom!
I think he and Roy Palmer work together. Yeah. Here comes your wife.
Well, yeah, I knew Roy Palmer, but I don't know too much of. Much of Roy Palmer. You know who else I played with? What's that family's name? He's in New York, isn't it?
He's in New York?
Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
